title: K Lane is taking over the music industry by Storm With the release of his latest single, "Only Chick"
htmlContent:
American Based artist K Lane is a talented rapper and songwriter who is currently making a name for himself with his fresh yet polished sound, "Only Chick." K Lane specializes in dreamy, heartfelt vocals backed by an infectious, melody-driven production style.

K Lane's "Only Chick" is that engaging music experience that is a must-hear sound. It's the music you can play, acknowledge the talent you hear in the record, and be a fan of the supreme talent presented to enjoy yourself limitlessly.
